question: Which kūṭa is designated as the first within the trikūṭa structure?
premises: Vāgbhava is named as a kūṭa.
Vāgbhava is designated as the first.
Kāmarāja is named in relation to the trikūṭa group.
inference: Within the trikūṭa structure, vāgbhava is the first kūṭa.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of kāmarājaṃ trikūṭakam in this half-verse is compressed.
plain_english: The vāgbhava is the first kūṭa, and kāmarāja belongs to the three-kūṭa group.
